---
title: "Offline tools"
---

The engine is plain C++ with no plug-in framework, so the same code runs in command-line tools. Build them with
the rest of the project (see [Development](../development.qmd)); they end up in `build/tools/`. For a quick
engine-only build: `cmake -S . -B build -DMSE_BUILD_PLUGIN=OFF && cmake --build build`.

## mse-render

Processes a WAV file through the engine exactly as a host would, with a steady clock.

```sh
build/tools/mse-render [options] <input.wav> <output.wav>
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--preset <file>` | A preset file (timed `@bar` lines are applied during the render). |
| `--set key=value` | Set one parameter; repeatable, applied after the preset. |
| `--bpm <bpm>` | Host tempo (default 120). |
| `--free` | No host tempo (free-running clock). |
| `--block <n>` | Block size in samples (default 512). |
| `--tail <sec>` | Append silence to hear echo tails. |
| `--seed <n>` | Random seed (encoding failure, dropouts, sampling…). Renders are deterministic for a given seed. |
| `--load-memory <dir>` | Start with a saved memory. |
| `--save-memory <dir>` | Save the memory at the end. |
| `--pcm24` | Write 24-bit PCM instead of 32-bit float. |

`mse-render --help` lists every parameter with its range and default. It also reports CPU use (how many times
faster than real time, and the slowest block).

```sh
build/tools/mse-render --preset presets/examples/05_no_self_match.txt --set power=5 in.wav out.wav
```

## mse-testgen

Writes deterministic synthetic test material: drums, chords and bass, a melody, clicks on every beat, a mid-file
style change and a full mix.

```sh
build/tools/mse-testgen [--sr 48000] [--bpm 120] [--bars 16] [--seed 1] [--pcm24] <output-dir>
```

## Rendering all the examples

```sh
build/tools/mse-testgen test-audio
scripts/render_examples.sh build renders
```

renders every preset in `presets/examples/` (CI does this on every push and publishes the audio on the
[listening page](../listening.qmd)).

## mse-ui-snapshot

Draws the plug-in window to a PNG without opening a window, after playing generated audio through the plug-in.
It is how the screenshots in this manual are made.

```sh
build/plugin/mse-ui-snapshot out.png [width height] ["preset name"] [row to select]
```
